name: Horse
description: A horse is a large, domesticated mammal known for its speed, strength, and grace. It has been used by humans for transportation, work, and companionship for centuries and is valued for its ability to cover long distances quickly.

actions.name: Hoof Strike
actions.description: The horse strikes a target with its hoof, dealing damage.

actions.name: Buck
actions.description: When a creature moves in or out of the horse's area of control, it bucks its hind legs, dealing physical damage.

actions.name: Gallop
actions.description: After using the Move action, the horse gallops to gain extra speed and travels an additional 2 units. If the horse uses the Move action again on this turn, they gain the bonus 2 units again.

traits.name: Easily Frightened
traits.description: If the horse is afraid, it must always move it's full movement away from the source of it's fear as it's reaction. Additionally, while it remains afraid, it cannot act on it's turn except by using one action to move it's full speed away. If the horse is being ridden, the rider may make an animals check of 7 or higher to prevent the horse from taking this action.
